# Model Router

> Model Router (`model-router`) is an open-source Claude Code plugin that sets the Claude model and reasoning effort of every agent Claude Code starts (subagents, agent-team teammates and workflow stages), choosing the cheapest model that should do the job and running a call one level higher when its work comes back for a redo. Apache-2.0 license. Needs Claude Code 2.1.326 or later and Python 3.9 or later.

Facts, each with its source:

- The ladder: lookup runs on Haiku at medium effort, standard on Sonnet at medium, complex on Sonnet at high, hardest on Opus at high, frontier on Fable at high. Source: plugins/model-router/config/models.json.
- Redo escalation: the same call issued again in the same request after its result came back runs one level higher. At least 6 votes that are also at least 30% of a level's calls raise that level. Source: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
- Who decides the model, strongest first: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE, a model named on the call, a per-agent rule in model-router.json, the agent's own model field, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, then the router's pick. Source: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
- Measured on the routing code at commit 780ee86, 10 runs per task class and configuration, beside every baseline. On an Opus 5.5 session the router cost $0.119 per solved task against $0.152 for Claude Code's defaults (21% less), 80 of 80 runs solved each, but more than opusplan ($0.069) and every subagent on Haiku at high effort ($0.075) in all 8 task classes (FAIL against the best baseline). On a Sonnet session it is cheapest only in lookup and costs more per solved task than the best baseline in 7 of 8 classes at the same pass rate (FAIL). Source: docs/BENCHMARKS.md and docs/TRACEABILITY.md row S4.15.
- Privacy: no prompt, brief, path or code leaves the machine. The only network traffic is a daily fetch from code.claude.com and platform.claude.com, and api.anthropic.com for the account's model list when an Anthropic API key is set. Source: docs/SECURITY.md.
